findings.title: Degraded evidence bypasses citation validation
findings.detail: When evidence.status is 'degraded', the statement evidence_ids check against evidence.hits is skipped. Production degraded findings carry no hits (evidence_analysis.py constructs status='degraded' only when findings is empty), so a draft can cite an arbitrary fabricated UUID and still return a SolutionAnalysis.
findings.probe: A SolutionStatement with a random UUID and kind='fact' was accepted with status='degraded'; the same statement was rejected with status='content'.
findings.expected: Every returned statement's evidence_ids must be a subset of evidence.hits for every status that is allowed to continue.

findings.title: Unsupported requirement can be contradicted by a statement
findings.detail: Only commitments are checked against unsupported_ids. A draft that marks req-1 unsupported but also returns a statement with requirement_ids=('req-1',) claiming the missing capability is accepted unchanged.
findings.probe: A draft with UnsupportedRef('req-1') and a fact statement referencing req-1 was accepted; result.statements[0].requirement_ids was ('req-1',).
findings.expected: Statements (and any other structured requirement references) must not include requirements listed as unsupported; otherwise raise SolutionContractViolation.

findings.title: Empty evidence loses its degradation marker
findings.detail: executed_checks adds 'evidence_degraded' only when status == 'degraded'. status == 'empty' continues with only the three base checks, so the output cannot distinguish an evidence-backed plan from an empty-evidence plan.
findings.probe: An EvidenceFinding with status='empty' and no hits returned executed_checks=('unsupported_preserved', 'commitments_non_binding', 'statement_classification').
findings.expected: Preserve a stable marker for empty evidence (for example 'evidence_empty') or carry the evidence degradation state in the output, per task.toml [decision].evidence_scope.

scope_check.note: debf440 is planner-owned task metadata (task.toml, prompts, red.json); no domain, migration, access, API or frontend changes.
